result.summary: This change updates wallet coin selection and coin fetching to detect when MiniMiner fails to calculate individual bump fees for unconfirmed UTXOs. It changes AvailableCoins to return util::Result<CoinsResult> and handles empty fee calculation results in FetchSelectedInputs and AvailableCoins. Instead of letting map::at throw an internal exception when cluster limits are reached, the wallet now returns a descriptive user-facing error.
result.problem: When spending unconfirmed UTXOs whose cluster in the mempool exceeds MiniMiner's cluster limit (500 transactions), bump fee calculation returns an empty map. The wallet previously looked up requested outpoints in that empty map using map::at, crashing transaction construction with a cryptic map::at exception exposed over RPC.
evidence: Issue #29711 describes wallet funding failing with the nondescript error message 'map::at' when creating a 502nd unconfirmed transaction.

PR diff updates mini_miner fuzz testing, miniminer unit tests, and adds a regression test in wallet_spend_unconfirmed.py reproducing the 501-unconfirmed-transaction cluster limit failure across send and sendall.
result.scope_notes: Changes the signature of wallet::AvailableCoins to return util::Result<CoinsResult>, requiring Assert or CHECK_NONFATAL unwrapping across call sites in RPCs, unit tests, and benchmarks.
result.card: This PR handles MiniMiner bump fee calculation failures during wallet transaction creation and sendall. When unconfirmed transactions exceed mempool cluster limits (500 transactions), bump fee calculations return an empty map, which previously triggered an uncaught map::at exception returned to users. The PR converts AvailableCoins to return a util::Result and surfaces a descriptive error explaining that unconfirmed UTXOs depend on an enormous cluster of unconfirmed transactions. It fixes issue #29711 and includes unit, fuzz, and functional regression tests.
